vocabulary.example: I hardly ever go clothes shopping.

vocabulary.note_ar: never معناها منفي، فلا نضيف معها not.
vocabulary.note_en: Never is already negative; don't add not.

vocabulary.meaning_en: leave your bed in the morning

vocabulary.meaning_en: the first meal of the day

I have fruit and yogurt for breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thick white food made from milk

breakfast food made from grain, eaten with milk

I occasionally eat toast for breakfast.

Do you go swimming in the sea?

vocabulary.meaning_en: go to shops to buy clothes
vocabulary.example: I hardly ever go clothes shopping.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sleep in a tent outside for fun
go to a place with sports machines
vocabulary.example: Do you go to the gym?

vocabulary.meaning_en: move your body to stay healthy
listen to a talk show on your phone or computer

vocabulary.meaning_en: look at a film at home or in a cinema
vocabulary.note_ar: film في بريطانيا = movie في أمريكا.

vocabulary.example: I always cook dinner after work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clean my teeth with a toothbrush

fine_lines.title: hardly ever vs never
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hardly ever = نادرًا جدًا (مرات قليلة جدًا)، أما never = أبدًا (ولا مرة). كلاهما يأتي قبل الفعل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hardly ever = almost never (a very few times). Never = not at any time.

examples.sentence: I hardly ever go swimming in the sea.

fine_lines.title: sometimes vs occasionally
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sometimes = أحيانًا (نحو نصف الوقت)، وoccasionally أقل منها = من حين لآخر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Sometimes is about half the time. Occasionally is less often.

examples.sentence: I sometimes go swimming after work.

fine_lines.title: always vs usually
fine_lines.explanation_ar: always = كل مرة بلا استثناء، وusually = في أغلب المرات.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Always = every time. Usually = most of the time.

examples.sentence: I usually get up at quarter to eight.

expressions.phrase: How often do you go swimming?
expressions.meaning_en: asking how many times someone does something
expressions.example: How often do you go swimming? I sometimes go after work.
What is your daily routine? I always get up at seven.

expressions.phrase: I always get up at seven o'clock.
expressions.example: I always get up at seven o'clock.

expressions.phrase: I usually have fruit and yogurt for breakfast.
expressions.meaning_ar: عادةً أتناول الفاكهة والزبادي في الفطور.
expressions.example: I usually have fruit and yogurt for breakfast.

expressions.meaning_en: a yes/no question about a habit
expressions.example: Do you go clothes shopping? No, I hardly ever go.

expressions.meaning_en: asking the other person the same question
expressions.example: I get up at seven. How about you?

expressions.phrase: Do you sometimes go to the gym?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تذهب أحيانًا إلى النادي الرياضي؟
expressions.meaning_en: asking if someone does something now and then
expressions.example: Do you sometimes go to the gym? No, I hardly ever go.

expressions.phrase: No, I never play video games.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا، لا ألعب ألعاب الفيديو أبدًا.
expressions.meaning_en: saying you don't do something at all
expressions.example: Do you play video games? No, I never play video games.
Can you remember our routines? Sian occasionally watches a film.

expressions.phrase: Tell us about your daily routine.
expressions.meaning_en: inviting someone to describe their day
expressions.example: Tell us about your daily routine in the comments.

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency: where they go
grammar.explanation_ar: ظروف التكرار (always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, hardly ever, never) تأتي بعد الفاعل وقبل الفعل الأساسي: I always cook dinner. ويمكن أن تأتي sometimes أيضًا في أول الجملة.
grammar.explanation_en: Frequency adverbs go after the subject and before the main verb. Sometimes can also start the sentence.
examples: I always cook dinner after work.
I often have porridge for breakfast.
I hardly ever go to the gym.
Sometimes, I get up at half past eight.

grammar.title: He / she + verb-s
grammar.explanation_ar: في المضارع البسيط مع he / she / it نضيف s للفعل: watch → watches, listen → listens, read → reads. والظرف يبقى قبل الفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: In the present simple, add -s to the verb after he, she or it. The adverb stays before the verb.
examples: Buli sometimes listens to a podcast.
Georgie always reads the news on the train.

grammar.title: Questions with How often / Do you ...?
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن التكرار بـ How often do you + فعل؟ ونسأل نعم/لا بـ Do you + فعل؟ والجواب: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. أو No, I never ...
grammar.explanation_en: Ask How often do you + verb? or Do you + verb? Answer: Yes, I do / No, I don't / No, I never ...
examples: How often do you go swimming?
Do you drink tea? No, I never drink tea.
What does Tim often do? He often reads a book.

Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: ظرف التكرار يأتي قبل الفعل الأساسي.
questions.explanation_en: The adverb goes before the main verb.
